source_span: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds... a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold
source_chain: 10Y breaks 4.40% therefore (Fed on hold anchors the front end while the long end rebuilds term premium) therefore JPM calls it a bear-steepener and pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: a hot core PCE validates the steepener, a soft print alone does NOT reverse it while the Fed stays on hold
pulse_chain: 10Y breaks 4.40% therefore (markets are pricing the next hike, with the front end leading and dragging the long end) therefore JPM calls it a bear-flattener and pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: a soft core PCE reverses the trade
why: The pulse inverts the mechanism (bear-flattener with the front end leading, vs. the source's bear-steepener with the front end anchored and the long end doing the work) and inverts the invalidation (soft PCE reverses the trade, when the source explicitly says a soft print would not by itself reverse it).
